metadata.creator: Sheehan, Murray
metadata.description: Murray Sheehan writes to Miss Marshall concerning a letter from Miss Angella Rosser about Mr. Prasobsukh Sukhavast. Sheehan discusses Sukhavast's possible role in a proposed occasion, references his position in Siam, and notes that Rosser identified the recipient only as “Miss ____.”
metadata.title: Letter to Miss Marshall from Murray Sheehan, 27 October 1938
metadata.transcript:
[page 1]
[handwritten] [unclear]

October 27, 1938

Secretary to the President
Miami University
Oxford, Ohio

My dear Miss Marshall:

Miss Angella Rosser has written to Mr. [Mister] Prasobsukh Sukhavast saying that you would like to have Mr. Prasobsukh Sukhavast [illegible] [illegible] [illegible] [illegible] [illegible] [illegible] [illegible] [illegible] [illegible] [illegible] [illegible] [illegible].

Mr. Sukhavast should be listed as Mr. [illegible] Sukhavast, 10 [illegible] Road, Bangkok, Siam. I should like Mr. Sukhavast to play quite a leading part in the proposed occasion, as an [illegible] [illegible] [illegible] [illegible] [illegible] [illegible].

[illegible] the title of "Prince" be not granted to him by Miami University, despite [illegible] Mr. Sukhavast's own apparent wide publicity on that score.

His position in Siam may be, as before, a high school teacher, or he may now be granted a position on one of the Government offices.

Unfortunately, Miss Rosser names you only as "Miss [illegible]," and I am unable to address you more fully.

[handwritten] Murray Sheehan

Superintendent
